title: Trenches To Benches
joke: One soldier stuck in a trench is confused while the other cheerfully builds benches, because if you can't leave yet you can at least sit down and keep going.

title: The Dream Subscription
joke: A man on the couch with a dusty dumbbell explains his unused gym pass is really a subscription to the dream.

title: Rolling Start Date
joke: A budget calendar where every month says next month, proudly called a rolling start date.

title: Watched Pot
joke: Someone stares at a coin sprout with a magnifying glass, while the sign says compounding works best when ignored.

title: So Close
joke: A runner on a minimum-payments treadmill chases a debt free sign bolted to the treadmill itself.
